title: Weakly supervised deep learning links breast cancer histology to molecular status
summary: Weakly supervised deep-learning models on H&E slides performed tumor detection and subtype classification, validated in independent cohorts with AUC of at least 0.950. The models also predicted estrogen/progesterone/HER2 receptor status, PAM50 status and TP53 mutation status from morphology, and learned lymphocyte-specific signals for estrogen receptor status.
ai_technology: Weakly supervised deep-learning models on hematoxylin-and-eosin whole slide images

evidence.tested: Independent cohorts for detection and subtyping (AUC at least 0.950).
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; performance for receptor, PAM50 and TP53 prediction not stated in the abstract; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicted molecular status from slide morphology and revealed lymphocyte-related signal.
